items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: these two fellas, you know, Gaspin, Vic Gaspin, why I know them so well, they were friends of the families

ctx.x: Yeah. Different type of music all together. Yeah.

But I know a lot of those fellas, but I couldn't recall their names. I was such a young kid and I seen them. I was around them when they were rehearsing with my daddy's band and all. And I've seen them go rehearsing in the halls and I went there with my brothers to hear them rehearsing, but I know the fellas when I seen them, just like I know these fellas' pictures, remember seeing them, playing with me when I was four, but I couldn't remember all those guys' names. But these two fellas, you know, Gaspin, Vic…
And he lived up until 1942 about. Yeah.
